title: Memory Layer Schema
description: JSON Schema for memory layer definitions in Legends of Kai-Jax. Memory layers are behavioral modifiers that stack with every tail unlock.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier for this memory layer

tail_number.description: The tail number this memory is associated with (1-9)

description.description: Narrative description of this memory and its significance

read.description: The core lesson or truth this memory teaches

gameplay_effects.description: The gameplay effects this memory layer provides

perception_shifts.description: How this memory changes how the world appears to the player

behavior_modifications.description: How this memory changes how the player acts and feels in combat

enemy_reactions.description: How enemies respond differently due to this memory

world_interactions.description: How the world reacts differently due to this memory

stacking_rule.description: How this memory stacks with others (always cumulative)

persistence.description: Persistence rule for this memory (always irreversible)
